source_quote:
To avoid performing to_dtype per-layer, you should do to_dtype to `self.e_score_correction_bias` of `AscendFusedMoe`.
Is it certain that the functionality of `torch_npu.npu_moe_gating_top_k_softmax` are included in `torch_npu.npu_moe_gating_top_k`?
Provide pre- and post-replacement performance data to prevent degradation.
You can delete this code.
The necessity here is that GLM4 uses fp32 for gate. So we have to do this dtype transform here.

rule.description: 在对 MoE gating top-k 算子进行泛化时，不应将算子调用变为无条件执行，需保留对不同 MoE 配置（如 softmax/sigmoid、grouped/non-grouped）的条件判断逻辑。
checkpoints: 泛化算子时是否保留了 fallback 路径
是否在 AscendFusedMoe 初始化时统一处理 dtype 转换，而非逐层执行
是否提供了替换前后的性能对比数据

antipattern.code:
# 评审人: whx-sjtu 👤 (2025-09-23)
# Commit: 023dad3 (refactor gatingtopk)
# 每层推理时重复执行 to_dtype 转换，性能不佳

def select_experts(
    self,
    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
    top_k: int,
    ...
):
    """Select top-k experts for MoE routing."""
    # ...
    # 每层推理时都执行 to_dtype，性能不佳
    logits = self.e_score_correction_bias.to(dtype)
    # ...
    topk_weights, topk_ids = torch_npu.npu_moe_gating_top_k(
        hidden_states,
        logits=logits,
        top_k=top_k,
        norm_type=1,
        ...
    )
    return topk_weights, topk_ids

# 在 AscendFusedMoe 初始化时对 e_score_correction_bias 统一做 to_dtype
# 备注: GLM4.5 is special, it use float32 to calculate, but in
# AscendFusedMoE::init() e_score_correction_bias changed dtype from
# float32 to bfloat16, this is different from deepseek and qwen models.

class AscendFusedMoE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ...):
        super().__init__()
        # ...
        # 在初始化时统一做 to_dtype，避免每层重复执行
        self.e_score_correction_bias = self.e_score_correction_bias.to(dtype)

    def select_experts(self, hidden_states, top_k, ...):
        """Select top-k experts for MoE routing."""
        # ...
        # 不再需要每层执行 to_dtype
        logits = self.e_score_correction_bias
        # ...
        topk_weights, topk_ids = torch_npu.npu_moe_gating_top_k(
            hidden_states,
            logits=logits,
            top_k=top_k,
            norm_type=1,
            ...
        )
        return topk_weights, topk_ids
